Switch input method
behaviour: Held, Win+Space lists the input methods with their layouts, the current one marked; each further Space moves the highlight, and letting Win go switches to it. Esc does not cancel.

label: Composition
behaviour: Typed kana stay underlined in the field as a composition; Space converts it in place and a second Space opens the vertical candidate list below the caret, the current choice marked with a bar; digits pick, PageDown and the arrows below turn pages, Tab opens the table view, Esc cancels.

label: Composition
behaviour: Pinyin stays underlined in the field while the horizontal candidate list shows below it; Space or a digit commits a candidate, PageDown and the arrows turn pages, Esc cancels.
